title: ZLP Manufacturing Recalls Hornet Zip Line Trolleys Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The retaining pin can release and cause the two side plates of the trolley to separate and fall off the zip line, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 2,000.

title: Air Movers Recalled by Packaging Tape Inc. Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The air mover/blower's thermal switch can fail and cause the motor to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,800.

title: Canon Recalls to Repair PowerShot SX50 HS Digital Cameras
summary: A chemical used in the rubber part of the viewfinders on the camera can cause skin or eye irritation or an allergic reaction to the user. Units: About 14,000.

title: Design Ideas Recalls Magnets Due to Risk of Ingestion
summary: The small magnets can easily detach from the product. If swallowed, magnets can link together inside a child's intestines and clamp onto body tissues, causing intestinal obstructions, perforations, sepsis and death. Internal injury from magnets can pose serious lifelong health effects. Units: About

title: Tektro USA and TRP Recall Mechanical Disc Brake Calipers Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The brake cable actuator arm can over-rotate, dislocating parts, causing the brake calipers to fail. Lack of brakes results in loss of control and a crash hazard, posing a risk of injury to the rider and others Units: About 2,000.

title: Fitness Anywhere Recalls TRX Dip and Hammer Bars Due to Risk of Injury (Recall Alert)
summary: The welds on the bars can crack or break and cause the user to fall, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 2,700.

title: Hitachi Koki Recalls Grass Trimmers Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The grass trimmers can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards to the consumer. Units: About 115,000 units in the United States and 12,400 in Canada.

title: Twin-Star Recalls Duraflame Electric Space Heaters Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The heater can overheat and cause the units to melt, catch fire and ignite nearby items, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 31,000.

title: Bedz King Recalls Bunk Beds with Side Ladder Due To Entrapment Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: A protruding corner post on the bunk beds exceeds the 5mm allowed by industry standard, posing an entrapment hazard. Units: About 2,900.

title: IKEA Recalls Children's Bed Canopies Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: An infant or young child can get entangled at the neck in the canopy's fabric, posing a strangulation hazard. Units: About 255,000 in the United States, 7,000 in Canada and 2.6 million worldwide.

title: Minga Fair Trade Imports Recalls Wooden Flipping Acrobat Toys Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The paint on the wooden flipping acrobat toys contains excessive levels of lead, which is prohibited under federal law. Units: About 135 units.

title: Ganz Recalls Grumpy Cat Stuffed Animal Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The stuffed animals' eyes can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 8,200.

title: Vera Bradley Recalls Bear Ring Rattles and Bunny Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The pom-pom tail can detach from the body of the bear rattle and the bunny, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 98,000.

title: Arctic Cat Recalls Off-Highway Utility Vehicles Due to Fuel Leak and Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Fuel can leak from the fuel fitting at the throttle body of the vehicle, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,300.

title: Schneider Electric Recalls Square D-Brand F and K Frame Circuit Breakers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The circuit breaker can fail to trip when an overload occurs, posing the risk of fire, burn and electric shock. Units: About 28,400.

title: MobilePower Recalls Multi-Function Power Packs Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively by QVC (Recall Alert)
summary: The power packs can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 9,800.

title: BMC Recalls Stromer Electric Bicycles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
summary: The bicycle fork can break, posing a crash and injury hazard to the rider. Units: About 1,300 in the U.S. and 11 in Canada.

title: The Conran Shop Recalls Pondicherry Dining Tables Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard (Recall Alert)
summary: The lacquer paint on the furniture can contain excessive levels of lead, a violation of the federal lead paint standard. Units: 28.

title: TJX Recalls Autumn 2013 Gardeners Eden Light-Up Decorations Due to Fire Hazard; Sold exclusively at T.J. Maxx, Marshalls and HomeGoods Stores
summary: Exposed wiring near the battery box can lead to a short circuit, posing a fire hazard Units: About 4,600.

title: Fitbit Recalls Force Activity-Tracking Wristband Due to Risk of Skin Irritation
summary: Users can develop allergic reactions to the stainless steel casing, materials used in the strap, or adhesives used to assemble the product, resulting in redness, rashes or blistering where the skin has been in contact with the tracker. Units: About 1,000,000 in the U.S. and about 28,000 in Canada.

title: Therapedic of New England Recalls Mattresses Due to Violation of Federal Mattress Flammability Standard; Sold at BJ's Wholesale Club (Recall Alert)
summary: The mattresses fail to meet the mandatory federal open flame standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,700.

title: Excel Industries Recalls BigDog and Hustler Mowers due to Risk of Injury (Recall Alert)
summary: The seat switch can fail to detect that the rider has left the seat, allowing the mower to continue to operate, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 3,700.

title: Lenovo Recalls Battery Packs for ThinkPad Notebook Computers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The battery packs can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 34,500 in the United States and 2,900 in Canada.

title: SATCO Products Recalls KolourOne LED Light Bulbs Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The metal housing/lens assembly can separate from the bulb's base and fall. This poses a risk of injury from impact to bystanders. Units: About 119,000 in the U.S. and 2,350 in Canada.

title: Ace Hardware Recalls LED Clamp Light Due to Shock and Fire Hazard
summary: The cord bushing inside the light base could fail, allowing the cord wiring to pull out of the base, exposing bare wire and presenting a shock and fire hazard. Units: About 15,000.

title: Centex Homes Recalls Solar Panels Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Fire Units: About 240 homes.

title: Wal-Mart Recalls Dolls Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The circuit board in the chest of the doll can overheat, causing the surface of the doll to get hot, posing a burn hazard to the consumer. Units: About 174,000.
